title: SG-11.2.2 Store and release the transitionTo unsubscribe in BootScene
summary: BootScene keeps the transitionTo unsubscribe function and calls then clears it on SHUTDOWN
description: Context: BootScene.create subscribes to the transitionTo event through reactToPhaser.on and already keeps the returned function in the private field unsubscribeTransition. The SHUTDOWN handler already calls and nulls it. Desired behavior: the stored unsubscribe is called and cleared on SHUTDOWN, so a restarted scene does not hold duplicate transitionTo handlers. Expected result: exactly one fade-out per transitionTo event after any number of scene restarts. Why: a duplicate handler would fade and start the scene several times.
acceptance_criteria: Given BootScene.create has run, when transitionTo is emitted, then exactly one fadeOut call is made
Given the SHUTDOWN callback has run, when transitionTo is emitted, then no fadeOut and no scene.start happens
Given the scene was shut down and created again, when transitionTo is emitted, then fadeOut is called exactly once

in_scope: unsubscribeTransition field and SHUTDOWN handler in BootScene
preserve: fade-out then scene.start behavior of transitionTo

technical_constraints: No real Phaser or browser in tests
definition_of_done: Both requirements have Act and Verify units complete
